 Scout OP’s Mother Slams Bigg Boss 20 Promos, Says Edited Clips Are Creating A False Image Of Him
 Mahi Pillai | 13.NOV.2026 Link copied to clipboard 
 Scout OP’s mother has spoken up after a recent Bigg Boss 20 promo showed him shaving his head following an argument with Love Gill. His team’s latest post carries a voice note from her, in which she questions the way clips featuring her son are being presented. She also spoke about the pressure he has been dealing with inside the house and asked viewers to watch the complete episodes before forming an opinion about him.
 Scout OP’s Mother Says Bigg Boss 20 Promos Are Showing Him Out Of Context
 In the voice note, Scout OP’s mother brought up an earlier promo featuring host Salman Khan. She recalled how Salman Khan had to explain that an edited promo could give viewers an incomplete picture of what had happened. She said it was painful to see a similar situation playing out with her son. She also alleged that the show’s promos were using old clips, zooming in on certain moments and joining conversations from different occasions to create a misleading impression. Scout OP’s mother said her son has a life and career outside the show, and that his words and actions should not be presented without the full context. Speaking about his mental health, she said it was difficult to watch him deal with the pressure inside the house. She claimed that Scout had expressed his distress several times, but the same subjects continued to come up in promotional clips. She added that she was not asking for special treatment, only a fair chance for him to put his side across. The caption shared with the voice note also asked viewers not to judge Tanmay, Scout OP’s real name, based on the promos. It pointed out that even simple moments, such as adjusting his microphone, could be edited to make him appear angry. His mother requested viewers to wait for the full episodes before deciding what had happened.

 What Happened Between Scout OP And Love Gill In Bigg Boss 20 ?
 The latest promo showed Scout OP shaving his head after an argument with Love Gill . The disagreement started after Love objected to his remark about her pyjamas. She told him that she did not want to speak to him about it anymore. Scout later climbed an artificial snake structure in the garden area. Uditi Singh asked him not to jump, but he replied, “No, there is no option.” The promo then showed him entering the bathroom and shaving his head as Bekhayali from Kabir Singh played in the background. When Love asked him why he had done it, Scout replied, “Why are you sitting there stressed? Your stress is gone now.” He was later seen in tears.
